findings:
🔵 [cge-results-arm-binding] CUT/FOLLOW-UP scripts/check-guidance-eval.js:117-123 re-scores whatever `--results` file it is given, and nothing ties those rows to the pack ids in `--arm`. Result rows carry `arm:"change"` with no pack id or suffix, so a SHIP results file from a different change arm would also pass gate 2. Excluded because plan §2.8 only requires "re-running the scorer on the recorded results reproduces SHIP". Binding is by convention: preflight is wired in P8, and `stage-graph.v5.jsonl` is paired with the `-v5` change.json. Possible hardening: record the arm-manifest digest in each row and assert it in the gate.
🔵 [cell-at-intent-same-call-order] CUT/FOLLOW-UP evals/skill-onoff/lib/stage-graph-cell.js:259-270 pushes a call's stage-advance invocations into walk_raw before it evaluates that call's classify. As a result, `classify … && stage-advance --to research` in one Bash command marks the classify as not at_intent. This only produces false negatives (fail-closed) on the U0 consistency key and cannot inflate a SHIP. Excluded as an instrument-precision improvement rather than a correctness defect against the frozen rule.
🔵 [cell-session-mode-fallback] CUT/FOLLOW-UP evals/skill-onoff/lib/stage-graph-cell.js:248-251: when the session-mode JSON count does not match, the code falls back to `!is_error` (fail-open for `set`). This residual is already declared in amend-3 `residual[0]`, and the change from amend-2 is decided. Listed only for traceability.
